evidence.name: Charter of the United Nations, Articles 2 and 51
evidence.claim: Sovereign equality, peaceful dispute resolution, prohibition of force and self-defence provide foundational legal constraints.
evidence.implication: No forced territorial recognition or coercive settlement proposal.

evidence.name: OHCHR civilian-protection report: September 2026
evidence.claim: At least 328 civilians killed and 2,105 injured in Ukraine during September 2026 (documented minimum).
evidence.implication: Prioritize verified civilian protection and warn against undercounting.

evidence.name: Reuters: IAEA-facilitated Zaporizhzhia repair truce
evidence.confidence: Medium–high; independent repair outcome not established here
evidence.claim: Rosatom reported a locally scoped IAEA-mediated truce for power-supply repairs.
evidence.implication: Test narrow technical pause models, not a claim of general ceasefire.

evidence.name: OSCE support for monitoring a negotiated settlement
evidence.claim: OSCE leadership indicated readiness to support implementation monitoring, if authorized.
evidence.implication: Explore consent-based monitoring mandates and funding.

evidence.name: ICRC: value of neutrality for humanitarian work
evidence.claim: Neutral, independent and impartial intermediary activities include repatriation and reconnecting families.
evidence.implication: Respect confidentiality; do not publish sensitive cases or impose advocacy roles.

evidence.name: World Bank Group support to Ukraine: March 2026
evidence.confidence: High for published estimate; projections uncertain
evidence.claim: February 2026 RDNA5 estimated nearly US$588 billion in reconstruction needs over the following decade.
evidence.implication: Financing designs need audits, prioritization and local ownership.

evidence.name: Trystero: official getting started and connection requirements
evidence.claim: Both peers must share app ID, room ID, signaling strategy and password; some network pairs need TURN.
evidence.implication: Opt-in peer connection with room-code diagnostics and honest TURN fallback.

evidence.name: Trystero: signaling strategies
evidence.claim: Default Trystero uses public Nostr relays; signaling and data transport are distinct.
evidence.implication: Never claim network or relay availability in offline mode.
